title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Manage tasks from all agents in dedicated task pane
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 introduces a dedicated task pane that consolidates all tasks generated by AI agents across finance, purchasing, sales, and operations, allowing users to review, navigate to affected records, complete, or dismiss tasks from a single structured location.
key_points: A new dedicated task pane displays all agent-generated tasks in one place instead of scattered notifications across different pages
Users can review task details, navigate to affected records, complete tasks, dismiss them, and navigate between previous and next tasks
The feature benefits roles relying on AI workflows such as accountants, sales people, and managers who engage with multiple agents daily
Tasks include suggestions, validations, follow-ups, access to draft documents, and other agent-initiated actions
The task pane can be collapsed and reopened as needed, with an additional Agent Tasks page available for task management
features: Manage tasks from all agents in dedicated task pane
Show all agent tasks on a separate task pane

quotes.text: The task pane reduces friction by collecting all insights in a single location, minimizing missed tasks and improving throughput.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates how the feature improves user productivity and task visibility across multiple agents

quotes.text: Tasks include suggestions, validations, follow-ups access to draft documents, and other agent-initiated actions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the types of agent-generated content available in the task pane
